'''Rogun Matt'rik's fortress''' was located in a secret underground facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic War]] and served a base of operations for [[Rogun Matt'rik]] until he was confronted in it by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as the [[Voidhound]].
